trickyParts: The data home is exempted rather than listed because it is not re-derivable: Oh My Pi relocates its whole profile root to $XDG_DATA_HOME/omp where that directory exists, so a delete costs stored state rather than a rebuild. It is also the one unlisted path that can grow without bound, which is why the exemption tells the operator to measure it rather than to ignore it.
discoveredComplexity: Three rounds in a row on one paragraph, each a sentence that was true when written and false against the system it described: the remedy pointing at the intermediate per-role layout, the set missing tmp and uv, the set missing data under a claim of completeness. What finally made it checkable was not more care but a different kind of sentence — one whose claim can be enumerated against the renderer ('accounts for every directory this layout creates, either on its delete list or in the two exemptions below it') rather than asserted. A prose claim that cannot be mechanically checked against the code it describes will drift again.
